items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, we don't have much on the agenda other than the final services PMIs for the major Eurozone economies and the UK. The data is not going to change anything for the respective central banks, so the market reaction will likely be muted.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲时段 在欧洲时段，除了欧元区主要经济体和英国的最终服务业PMI数据外，议程上没有太多其他内容。这些数据不会对各相关央行的政策产生影响，因此市场反应预计将较为温和。
